semantic_content.answer: \((x^2-4)/(x-2)=x+2\) for \(x\ne2\). The original expression has domain \(\mathbb R\setminus\{2\}\). The simplified formula \(x+2\) is defined for every real number, so it is not equivalent to the original expression at every real number: at \(x=2\), the original is undefined whereas \(x+2=4\).
